title: ifft~

messages.description: real part of signal to transform
imaginary part of signal to transform

body:
[ifft~] does an inverse complex Fourier transform, turning the real and imaginary parts of a spectrum back into a complex signal.

The analysis size is one block, which you can set with [block~] or [switch~]. There is no normalization, so an FFT followed by an IFFT has a gain of N.
